_comment: Tool-neutral agent registry. Bodies live in agents/<name>.md. Run `node scripts/sync-agents.mjs` after editing either, then commit the generated .claude/ .codex/ .agents/ output.

agents.name: android
agents.description: Use this agent for the Android client at ../projects/android — Kotlin · Jetpack Compose · MVVM. Owns screens, view-models, and unit tests. Do NOT use for the backend (api), the web client (app), the iOS client (ios), the hub, or the board.

agents.name: api
agents.description: Use this agent for the backend service at ../projects/api — Node · Express · Postgres. Owns endpoints, schema and migrations, auth, business logic, and backend tests. Do NOT use for the web client (app), the mobile clients (android/ios), the hub, or the board.

agents.name: app
agents.description: Use this agent for the web client at ../projects/app — React · Vite · Tailwind. Owns routes, components, client state, and view-level tests. Do NOT use for the backend (api), the mobile clients (android/ios), the hub, or the board.

agents.name: ios
agents.description: Use this agent for the iOS client at ../projects/ios — Swift · SwiftUI · async/await. Owns views, view-models, and unit tests. Do NOT use for the backend (api), the web client (app), the Android client (android), the hub, or the board.

agents.name: ops
agents.description: Use this agent for releases, deploys, and anything at the public edge — production deploys, DNS/domain changes, published packages/registries, making a repo public, destructive migrations. The ONLY agent that touches the public edge, and every irreversible action is hard-gated on the Owner's explicit, per-action go. It does NOT write feature code — it ships what the surface agents built.
